title: A la vez que: dos procesos que ocurren simultáneamente

sections.content: A la vez que (at the same time as, while) links two things happening simultaneously -- often two processes moving in different or even contradictory directions at once. It's followed by a full clause. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: El número de funcionarios indígenas aumentó, a la vez que crecían también las organizaciones indígenas propias.
items.english: The number of Indigenous officials increased, at the same time as Indigenous organizations themselves also grew.

items.spanish: Esta declaración, a la vez que carecía de fuerza legal obligatoria, ofrecía un marco de referencia ampliamente citado.
items.english: This declaration, while lacking binding legal force, offered a widely cited frame of reference.

items.spanish: Persistían brechas profundas, a la vez que se multiplicaban estos avances políticos y simbólicos.
items.english: Deep gaps persisted, at the same time as these political and symbolic advances multiplied.

items.spanish: Los conflictos se multiplicaron a la vez que crecía la demanda global de materias primas.
items.english: Conflicts multiplied at the same time as global demand for raw materials grew.

sections.content: A la vez que is especially useful for holding two contrasting trends together in one sentence -- progress and persistent problems, gain and cost -- without needing a separate contrastive connector like pero or sin embargo.
